name: quota-bottle
description: An original octopus-shaped glass bottle that floats on your desktop and shows how much Token Plan quota is left from a login you configure yourself: the liquid level and opacity follow the remaining share, with a device-code login and an opt-in local token-usage fallback.
author: 7723qqq
exampleQueries: 打开额度瓶，看看我还剩多少额度
把额度瓶悬浮在桌面上，实时显示剩余额度
